issue.title: Android client renders and answers the Plan Decision Sheet over the mobile wire

task_type_fields.proposal: Render the Plan Decision Sheet in the Android client. Carry the frozen payload.decisions definitions and the current review_revision over the gateway/mobile wire, let the reviewer change values, and submit decision_<id> inputs plus review_revision, the same way ACE and Telegram do. Today Android approves with defaults, shows only the `N decisions · 🧠 M` note line, and labels nothing "as shown".
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Android client is a separate repo that is not linked to this project, so sase-1hi (plan section 5.11) left its Decision Sheet rendering out of scope. Proposed by sase-1hi.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3).

issue.creation_reason: Plan Decisions covers ACE, Telegram, and the CLI; the unlinked Android client still approves decision plans with defaults only.
